tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Page background (surface-page). Ground for text, muted, cyan and the gradient CTAs. Never pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on ink. Carries text, muted, cyan, green, amber and red as text.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised layer on surface: the active segment of a SegmentedControl, nested chips, hovered rows.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of panel gradients (surface to surface-deep) on Card variant panel and band.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px border on cards, inputs, ghost buttons and dividers.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet 1px divider inside cards (StatRow separators, feed rows, segmented track border, cover grid texture).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on ink, surface and surface-2 (15:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary and body copy at .88 to .94rem on ink, surface and surface-2 (5.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted-2
tokens.usage: Tertiary labels and mono captions on ink and surface (4.6:1 or better). Avoid on surface-2 in dark (4.65:1, borderline).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: LocomotePro Home / Lite edition colour, links, kickers, Em accent phrases, focus rings, drive-score gauge. As text on ink and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Electric Blue: LocomotePro Pro / Fleet edition colour and primary brand. Dark theme: 4.5:1 on ink only; use it for fills, borders and text 24px+ on surface and surface-2 (4.15:1 and 3.8:1). Source pair kept exact.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Moving, value, offers, positive status. Text on ink and surface. Light theme: 4.49:1 on ink, use on surface for small text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: GPS mandate, idle, caution, added cost. The amber mandate strip is the one left-border accent allowed. Light theme: 3.9:1 on ink and 4.3:1 on surface, so use it for text 24px+, bold labels or fills only (source pair kept exact).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Stopped, alert, errors. Text on ink and surface in both themes. Pair with a word or dot label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Stopped-vehicle dot and map markers. Not for text: 4.0 to 4.7:1 in dark, 3.8 to 4.3:1 in light (source value kept).

tokens.name: stopped
tokens.usage: Stopped status pill text and dot. Dark theme passes on all surfaces; light theme is 3.1 to 3.5:1, so keep the word label bold or use it for the dot only.

tokens.name: bd-green
tokens.usage: Bangladesh flag green: local cues only (flag chip, national motifs). Use sparingly, never as a UI accent.

tokens.name: bd-red
tokens.usage: Bangladesh flag red disc. Local cues only, used sparingly.

tokens.name: wa
tokens.usage: WhatsApp green: only the WhatsApp Button variant, with text #05240F.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Sticky nav and map legend backdrop, with backdrop-filter blur.

tokens.name: scrim-soft
tokens.usage: Lighter overlay for tags over maps and imagery.

tokens.name: scrim-solid
tokens.usage: Near-opaque overlay for open mobile menus.

tokens.name: input-bg
tokens.usage: Booking-form input fill (Input).

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Faint wash behind SegmentedControl tracks and quiet rows.

tokens.name: wash-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger wash for dividers on imagery and scrollbar thumbs.

tokens.name: tag-bg
tokens.usage: Floating map tags and vehicle labels.

tokens.name: panel-a
tokens.usage: Top stop of the wash panel gradient (Card variant wash, FeatureCard).

tokens.name: panel-b
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the wash panel gradient.

tokens.name: gauge-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of the DriveScore gauge.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Bangladesh outline fill on the live map motif.

tokens.name: map-edge
tokens.usage: Bangladesh outline stroke on the live map motif.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Hero headline. Fluid on the web: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.8rem). End with an accent phrase in cyan or the gradient. Sentence case.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading (SectionHead). Fluid on the web: clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem).

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a hero or section heading, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy. Set in muted on ink and surface; text for emphasis.
styles.sample: LocomotePro tracks every vehicle live, replays the route, and scores each drive from 0 to 100.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase section kicker in cyan. Letter-spacing .16em.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-labels, pill text, telemetry captions. Letter-spacing .14em. Middle dot as separator.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Inline telemetry and prices in mono.

styles.name: bn-heading
styles.usage: Bangla headings. Same message as the EN heading.

styles.name: bn-body
